beats.text: Mary Magdalene stayed behind at the tomb, weeping. When she was asked why she was crying, all she had was one answer.

beats.text: Why are you crying? he asked her. Who is it you're looking for? She did not know the voice yet. Through the tears, she could not even see his face.
